trickyParts: Playwright's page.clock.install() alone leaves the page clock running at real speed; page.clock.pauseAt(Date.now() + 1000) is what holds it still (the lead is for Node/page skew, as e2e/hover-preview.e2e.ts records). Without the pause, row C's held answer was overtaken by the second title's own 400 ms debounce and the row measured nothing.

With the page clock held, react-query delivers nothing: notifyManager batches its notifications on a zero-delay timer, which is one of the faked timers. Row C therefore needs one page.clock.runFor(1) after the response reaches the page before the dialog can have rendered it — without it the row passed whether the display gate was there or not, which is how the first draft's false green was found.
page.waitForTimeout is the page's clock and never returns under a held clock; row C's margin is Node's own timer (node:timers/promises).
The e2e harness has no embedder, so the check answers keywords_only with a search_note; the fixtures match on rare words and no row asserts the search mode's wording.

The web cannot import @legion/envoy-client, so the check's three forms are worded again in RelatedItems.tsx. RelatedForm tests the not-made form before the item list, in the same order as relatedCheckForm, so an answer carrying both reads the same on both surfaces.
deviations: The plan's task 1 named a types.ts re-export of Suggestions and WriteSuggestion only; RelatedCheckOutcome and RelatedCheckSearch were not needed and were not added.

The plan put RELATED_DEBOUNCE_MS in RelatedItems.tsx. It is in features/issue/related-timing.ts instead, a module importing nothing, because the Playwright spec reads the value the dialog runs on and importing a .tsx into the Node-side spec would pull React (the precedent is features/refs/ref-preview-timing.ts).
The not-made form names the words to search Dispatch for rather than a dispatch search command line, as plan decision 5 allows for the web.
discoveredComplexity: The pod had no browser harness. /legion/harness/setup.sh and env.sh build one on the issue volume: Postgres 18.6 with pgvector 0.8.7 from the PGDG trixie packages, ICU initdb, Playwright's Chromium, and the contracts bundle Playwright's Node resolution needs. Two packages the existing recipe does not name are required for Postgres 18: libnuma1 and liburing2, which the 18.6 postgres binary links for its io_uring AIO.

The simplify pass applied seven findings over three reviewers and left three: a shared useSettled hook and a shared pauseClock module would both edit files this pull request does not touch, and debouncing the project alongside the title (efficiency, confidence 0.45) would change row B's arithmetic for a cost that only arises when a keyboard user arrows through the project select mid-draft; the display gate already keeps a previous project's answer off screen.
